profile.name: 量子比特抽象控制对象
profile.description: 一个非物理的量子比特实验控制组件，用作量子比特参数容器和测量流程模板。它为超导量子比特实验统一组织 T1、Rabi、Ramsey、回波、单次读出、频谱、谐振腔搜索、通量调谐与多种校准流程，本身不是可独立连接的硬件仪器，而是供具体量子比特实现类继承的抽象基类。
profile.description_en: A non-physical qubit experiment control component that serves as a parameter container and measurement template for a qubit. It organizes T1, Rabi, Ramsey, echo, single-shot readout, spectroscopy, resonator search, flux tuning, and calibration workflows for superconducting qubit experiments. It is not a standalone hardware instrument, but an abstract base class intended for concrete qubit implementations.

registry.name: Thermo Fisher Scientific Qubit
registry.description: Qubit Fluorometer是由Thermo Fisher Scientific生产的表征设备，主要功能包括初始化、校准、测量、设备连接。支持Signal, Slot, add config parameters等操作。
